title: MECHANICAL
officialText:
1009.1 Mechanical requirements. Where the existing building or part of an existing building is
subject to a change of occupancy, mechanical systems serving the new occupancy or use shall
comply with Sections 1009.1.1 and 1009.1.2.
1009.1.1 Change in occupancy classification. Where there is a change in the occupancy
classification of the building or portion thereof, the building area subject to change shall
comply with all the requirements of the New York City Mechanical Code for the new
occupancy classification.
1009.1.2 A change of use within the same Occupancy Group. Where a building or space is
changed to a use with higher mechanical ventilation demand, the mechanical system serving
such building or space shall comply with the requirements of Section 809 or 909 as applicable.
